description: Cencora, Inc., a Delaware corporation, is one of the largest global pharmaceutical sourcing and distribution services companies, helping both healthcare providers and pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers improve patient access to products and enhance patient care. It delivers innovative programs and services designed to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of the pharmaceutical supply chain in both human and animal health, distributing a comprehensive offering of brand-name, specialty brand-name and generic pharmaceuticals, over-the-counter healthcare products, home healthcare supplies and equipment and related services to a wide variety of healthcare providers in the United States and select global markets, including acute care hospitals and health systems, independent and chain retail pharmacies, mail order pharmacies, medical clinics, long-term care and alternate site pharmacies, physician practices, medical and dialysis clinics and veterinarians. It serves its customers through a geographically diverse network of distribution service centers and other operations in the United States and select global markets, and in its pharmaceutical distribution businesses it is typically the primary supplier of pharmaceutical and related products to its healthcare provider customers.
